blocks.text: Classic comfort meets modern design with the Maggie Sofa, a versatile piece that elevates any living room. Its clean-lined silhouette and structured frame create a contemporary look, while plush, reversible cushions invite you to relax in style. Whether you’re lounging solo or entertaining guests, the high-resiliency foam cushions wrapped in poly fiber provide lasting support and comfort. Two accent pillows with feather-fiber fill add a cozy touch, perfect for curling up with a book or enjoying a glass of wine. Upholstered in soft, neutral polyester fabric, this sofa blends seamlessly with casual or modern decor. Exposed feet with a faux wood finish enhance its refined appeal. Built with a reinforced frame and a platform foundation system that resists sagging three times better than traditional spring systems, this sofa maintains a smooth, wrinkle-free look even after years of use. Ideal for everyday living, the Maggie Sofa combines durability, comfort and timeless style for your home.

items.label: OVERSIZED SOFA
items.value: Offering endless style possibilities, this is classic comfort with a mod twist. Its minimalistic approach and structured silhouette bring clean-lined design to your living room

items.label: POSITIVELY PLUSH CUSHIONS
items.value: You'll love sinking into this seat while relaxing solo or hosting guests. Its light textured upholstery suits casual and contemporary spaces for endless style options

items.label: QUALITY CONSTRUCTION
items.value: The sofa's platform foundation system offers even support. It maintains a tight, wrinkle-free look without the dipping/sagging that can occur with other foundations

items.label: DIMENSIONS
items.value: Measures 96" W x 40" D x 37" H. With the contemporary look of exposed feet in a faux wood finish, this sofa is a must-have piece of living room furniture

items.label: ARRIVES ASSEMBLED
items.value: Simply lay item on back to remove shipping cleats and screw in feet for instant enjoyment. Screwdriver (not included) required. Fits through doorways 32" or wider
